leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply forwardRef to resolve circular dependency issues in component references
Construct a component that exposes its DOM node using ElementRef
Configure a parent component to access a child component's DOM node via ViewChild
Implement a method that manipulates the exposed DOM node's properties
Initialize a template reference variable to bind to a child component
Update a parent component's view by controlling the child's exposed DOM element
Integrate forwardRef with ViewChild to access component instances before initialization
